text_block_list.text:
On the way to training
with Silence Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy~~~~!!!!
Found ya, Suzukaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?
(BOOOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Kya...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm sooo happy to meet youuu!

Taiki Shuttle suddenly came running over
and gave Silence Suzuka a big, energetic hug...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ohh, sorry☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine.
So... what's up?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oops! That is right!
Suzuka, let's have a partyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A party...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! A juicy steak
arrived from my family!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat together and toast with fresh milk!
Hehe, it'll be so much fun, desu yo~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy you invited me, but...
I'm not really good with noisy places..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! Today's party is
just for the two of us, me and Suzuka~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It is true that I absolutely LOVE
lively, buzzing parties with everyone, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
BUUUT! Today's guest is Suzuka, after all!
A calm and relaxing party is also very good!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Throwing a party that makes my guests happy
makes me happy as the host☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Taiki.
Um... is it okay if one more person joins?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If Suzuka calls for me,
then of course it's an okay from me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
If you'd like, would you care to join me?
choice_data_list: Make sure to get some proper exercise in before eating.
Make sure to get some proper exercise in before eating, okay?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
If you'd like, would you care to join me?
choice_data_list: Make sure to get some proper exercise in before eating.
Make sure to get some proper exercise in before eating, okay?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
A taste of Taiki's hometown... I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay!
Please wait with your neck stretched long!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll prepare a steak as big as the Rocky Mountains for us~!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I can't eat that much, you know?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right, let's get ready right awayyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... W-Wait, Taiki...!

At the party afterward, the three of us
somehow managed to polish off a mountain of steak.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...Taiki, can we wait until we're hungry to start the party?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course! In that case, I will
run with Suzuka and get hungry too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's a battle, Suzuka! The winner
gets all the steak they can eat~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"All-you-can-eat aside—
fufu, a contest sounds quite fun."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Get set!
Here we...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Gooo...!

Afterward, having worked up an appetite from running,
the two ate plenty of steak
to build up their stamina.
